description: This file defines an asynchronous function getTenantUsersSummary that fetches and normalizes a summary of users by tenant, utilizing an external function getTenantUsersSummaryStrict. It handles multiple data shape scenarios and includes error handling with logging.

methods.name: getTenantUsersSummary()
methods.description: Fetches tenant user summary data, normalizes the response into a consistent object with 'items' array and optional 'total' count, and handles errors.
